annotations.title: Look up a Hawaiʻi or New Hampshire parcel

description: Use this when someone asks about one Hawaiʻi lot by TMK or street address: zoning and its dimensional rules, State Land Use District, flood zone, Special Management Area, tsunami and sea level rise, lava zone and slope, each with its source. Answers questions about one Hawaiʻi lot, by TMK or street address: what is this parcel zoned and what are the dimensional rules (setbacks, height, lot coverage, density), what the county code lists for adding to the lot (an ADU or a second dwelling), is it in the Special Management Area (SMA), which State Land Use District (Urban, Rural, Agricultural, Conservation), what FEMA flood zone, is it in the tsunami evacuation zone, the 3.2 ft sea level rise flood zone or the Sea Level Rise Constraint District, the wildfire risk, the lava flow hazard zone on Hawaiʻi Island, elevation, slope and aspect, Important Agricultural Lands, soil series and farmland rating, wetlands and streams, historic properties nearby, nearest wells and depth to water, water and sewer service and cesspool records, landslide and dam zones, shoreline setback and vacation rental (TVR) standing on Kauaʻi, tax class and acres. One call returns every finding for the lot, each with its official county, State or federal source, and a permalink to cite. Also for one New Hampshire lot by address, NH_GIS_ID or point. In New Hampshire, by street address, NH_GIS_ID or a point: the parcel from the state parcel mosaic (NH_GIS_ID, town, map block lot, land use, mapped acres and the lot lines as GeoJSON) and the lot hazards at the point: FEMA flood zone, USFWS wetlands, USDA Forest Service wildfire hazard, USGS faults, USDA soil septic rating, USGS elevation and slope, and the EPA radon zone, each with its agency, layer, URL and date read.

address.description: Or a street address in Hawaiʻi or New Hampshire with town and state, e.g. 4-1345 Kuhio Hwy, Kapaa or 107 N Main St, Concord, NH

lat.description: Or a point in New Hampshire: latitude

nh_gis_id.description: Or a New Hampshire parcel id (NH_GIS_ID) from the state parcel mosaic, e.g. 074046-3019

tmk.description: Hawaiʻi Tax Map Key, 9 digits, dashes optional, e.g. 4-4-2-016-063
